PHASE INFORMATION.Phase Site Name: BioHealth Research Center - Molecular Biology Division
PHASE INFORMATION.Training/Internship Field: Molecular Biology Research (gene expression, protein interactions, assay development)
PHASE INFORMATION.Phase Site Address: 1201 Research Parkway, Suite 400, Bethesda, MD 20814, USA
PHASE INFORMATION.Description of Trainee/Intern's role for: The trainee will participate in hands-on laboratory research focused on characterization of gene expression pathways and protein interaction networks. Responsibilities include performing molecular cloning, PCR/qPCR, Western blotting, immunoprecipitation assays, cell culture maintenance, preparation of reagents and buffers, data collection, data entry into laboratory information management systems, routine equipment calibration, and contributing to weekly lab meetings and progress reports. The trainee will also assist in troubleshooting experiments and maintaining laboratory notebooks in accordance with institutional standards.
PHASE INFORMATION.Specific goals and objectives for this p: 1) Acquire proficiency in core molecular biology techniques (cloning, PCR/qPCR, Western blot, immunoprecipitation) and demonstrate accurate execution of at least five representative protocols by week 12. 2) Design and execute a small independent sub-project under supervision, including hypothesis generation, experimental planning, data collection, and preliminary analysis, resulting in a written interim report by week 20. 3) Develop competence in laboratory data management and interpretation, including use of LIMS and basic statistical analysis tools, demonstrated by proper documentation and presentation at the end-of-phase seminar. 4) Improve scientific communication skills through participation in weekly lab meetings and by delivering one oral presentation and one written summary of findings by phase end.
